text:
maggie_ml: FYI on aurelia-7b-lite post-launch — canary looked fine but we've started seeing two weird things in prod today: (1) embedding similarity scores drop ~12% on short queries vs canary baseline, (2) KV-cache repeats / token echo on prompts with very short system instructions. Also noticed some requests hitting fallback routing to 'aurelia-3b-fast' which increases hallucinations.

jason_infra: can you paste a repro request and the model config used for the canary?

maggie_ml: repro below (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "aurelia-7b-lite",
  "quant": "q4f16",
  "prompt": "Translate: hi ->",
  "max_tokens": 50,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```
Observed: repeated fragments like "hi -> hi ->" in ~3% of calls, and embedding cosine drops from 0.88 to ~0.77 on short paraphrase pairs.

nina_research: weird. Was the canary using q8_0 or q4f16? quant changes can shift embedding space.

maggie_ml: canary was q8_0 for latency A/B, but staged rollout used q4f16 on some capacity pools (weird mixing). Not intentional.

ryan_prod: that mixing is a routing bug — autoscaler can spin up different quant variants when capacity is tight. We have a policy to prefer same-quant within customer namespace. Did fallback routing kick in?

maggie_ml: yes, metrics show ~2.8% of requests were routed to a fallback pool running q4f16 on a cheaper GPU region. That's where hallucination surge happened.

jason_infra: action 1: pin quant at routing layer for canary customers. I'll add a quick policy override. Action 2: reproduce repeats locally with exact KV cache behavior.

sasha_eval: curious on evals — did you run the short-prompt suite (short-translation, fewshot-empty) against both quants? We saw embedding drift in older q4 tests.

maggie_ml: ran the short suite, numbers below:
- canary (q8_0): avg cosine 0.881
- prod-mixed (q4f16 subset): avg cosine 0.769
- baseline reference (fp16): 0.887
Repetition rate: q8_0 0.2%, q4f16 3.1%

nina_research: that gap is big. Two parallel hypotheses: quant-induced embedding distortion, or KV-cache application bug when switching kernel variants.

heejae_eng: we recently landed a fused-attn patch that changes KV stride for small sequence lengths. If a pool runs the new kernel but state was initialized with old cache layout, you can get wrap/echo. I'll check recent deploys.

deploy-bot: deploy event: 
- service: runtime-aus-2
- change: fused-attn v3 (opt for short-seq)
- time: 2498765000
- rollout: 20%

li_ops: ops note — runtime-aus-2 also hosts cheaper fallback pools (3b models) and some are q4f16-only. Mix + kernel delta seems like a risky intersection.

ryan_prod: prioritized fixes:
1) immediate: pin routing for canary customers to q8_0 across all pools (heatmap shows affected customers).
2) revert fused-attn v3 on pools serving aurelia-7b-lite until KV cache compat verified.
3) run targeted evals comparing q8_0/q4f16 + fused-attn v2/v3 for both generation and embeddings.

maggie_ml: +1 on all. Also seeing a small uptick in 429s when canary throttles hit and fallback kicks in. Could be compounding.

jason_infra: I'm pushing a quick routing override:
```
PATCH /routing/policies/canary-quant
{ "force_quant": "q8_0", "scope": "aurelia-7b-lite:canary" }
```
Should hit prod in ~2m.

sasha_eval: I'll schedule an overnight eval run with the following matrix: quants: [fp16, q8_0, q4f16], kernels: [v2, v3], workloads: [short-translate, embed-paraphrase, fewshot-chat]. Will report delta table tomorrow AM.

nina_research: for embeddings, compute pairwise cosine distribution and KL to baseline; for generation compute repetition rate + PPL on small prompts. Also capture top-k diversity.

heejae_eng: found an obvious suspect: fused-attn v3 changed the KV write stride for sequence lengths <= 8 to 16 bytes alignment. When cache restoration sees older layout it doesn't realign, causing duplicate reads. I'll open a patch to check layout version on cache attach.

li_ops: suggestion: add a rollout guard that prevents kernel changes on nodes hosting a model family unless cache layout version is backward-compatible. Quick guard can be a node label check.

ryan_prod: agree. Add to rollout checklist: "kernel layout compatibility" for any runtime kernel change.

maggie_ml: long-term: should we include embedding stability tests in the onboarding checklist? Right now we focus on generation and latency. This failure shows embeddings can regress silently.

sasha_eval: yes, add "short-query embedding drift" and "kernel-quant cross-check" to onboarding smoke. Also add a tiny synthetic KV-cache stress test that does rapid attach/detach.

jason_infra: rollback note: I've staged the routing override and started draining nodes with fused-attn v3 that host aurelia. If repeats persist after drain, we'll roll runtime patch.

maggie_ml: quick repro I ran locally to show echo:
```
# reproduce echo locally
python reproduce_echo.py --model aurelia-7b-lite --quant q4f16 --prompt "Translate: hi ->" --kv-mode attach
```
gives the duplicate tokens ~70% of the time in my reduced test.

nina_research: when you run reproduce, log raw KV lengths and a hexdump of the first 64 bytes of cache to confirm layout mismatch.

heejae_eng: opening issue: "kv-layout-version-check and compatibility guard" -> I will add a small header to KV snapshots with a 16-bit layout_version. Patch incoming.

li_ops: operational action items I will track:
- ticket ENG-1289: pin routing + drain v3 nodes (in progress)
- ticket ENG-1290: KV layout header + compatibility check (heejae)
- ticket ENG-1291: add embedding stability tests to onboarding smoke (sasha)
- ticket ENG-1292: rollout checklist update (ryan)

ryan_prod: set SLA: get routing pin live in 30m, drain complete in 2h, kernel compatibility patch in next release (48h).

maggie_ml: thanks team — I'll pause the aurelia canary expansion and annotate the model's onboarding doc. Opening a short incident postmortem with these notes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: routing override applied at 2498765600 by jason_infra.

maggie_ml: last note — this is a useful new onboarding checklist item: "ensure quant homogeneity across all pools for model family". I'll add to the onboarding template and link the eval matrix.

sasha_eval: acknowledged. I'll push eval results by 2498767000.

maggie_ml: closing loop for now, will update when we see reductions in repetition/embedding drift.
